scientific_scope_status: The developing producer construction proposes encoding the clock extension epsilon Y+partial_theta of a compact smooth flow into a finite-dimensional natural Hamiltonian with a smooth potential globally Hessian-close to the harmonic well and equal to it outside a compact annulus. Fixed quadratic position observables recover the stated smooth observables. Revision2 reports primary support for its local smooth free-isometric-embedding dependency and adds finite-Fourier/torus computational details.
